issue.title: Match Feedback, Install guide, What's New and About to shipping
issue.body:
**Parity unit U23** of the native UI port. The RN app must match the shipping Svelte/Capacitor app.

**Gaps (from the parity inventory):**

| # | Surface | Shipping file(s) | RN file(s) | Severity | Gap | Shots |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 42 | Install section / Install Guide | `settings/SetupInstructions.svelte`, app.css `.step-number`, `design/Disclosure.svelte` | `rsdDrawing/RsdInstallGuide.tsx`, `install/installCopy.ts`, `install/installPolicy.ts` | looks wrong | Steps are run-together paragraphs. Missing: the RuleLabel OS heading, the numbered step disclosures, and the "Keep kids in the app" (Guided Access / App Pinning) step. | `settings-install` |
| 43 | Feedback section (Report form) | `settings/ReportForm.svelte`, `report/ReportFields.svelte`, `design/StatusMessage.svelte` | `rsdDrawing/RsdFeedbackSheet.tsx`, `feedback/*` | looks wrong | A separate full-screen sheet reached from Drawing tools, not from Settings. It has (1) chip type picker, (2) a "0 / 4000 characters" counter, (3) device details as a full-width button, (4) two long privacy paragraphs, (5) a "Review feedback" step and "Close feedback". It has no card, checkbox, or "What will be sent?" disclosure. | `settings-feedback` |
| 44 | What's New (Updates) | `settings/WhatsNewSection.svelte`, `settings/CurrentReleaseNotes.svelte`, `ReleaseSectionHeading.svelte` | `rsdDrawing/RsdWhatsNewSection.tsx`, `settings/whatsNew.ts` | minor | Closest section. It lists every release instead of the current one plus a "See all releases" link. There are no New/Improved/Fixed icons, and bullets are typed "•" characters. | `settings-whats-new` |
| 45 | About section | `settings/AboutSection.svelte`, `SplotchyIcon.svelte`, `design/ExternalMark.svelte` | `NativeDialog.tsx` (`about` case), `rsdDrawing/RsdInformationSection.tsx`, `information/content.ts` | looks wrong | One "Help and about" button opens long text pages. Missing: the Splotchy mark, the tagline, the Privacy Policy / GitHub links, and the version line. | `settings-about` |
| 58 | Standalone pages linked from Settings (`/privacy`, `/changelog`) | `page/PageShell.svelte`, `page/RuleLabel.svelte`, `page/BrandMark.svelte`, `CrayonStrip.svelte`, `web/src/routes/privacy`, `web/src/routes/changelog` | `RsdInformationSection.tsx` (Help, Privacy and What's new text pages) | looks wrong | RN has in-app plain-text pages with no page shell, crayon-strip masthead or rule labels. | `settings-about` |

**Done when:** the RN surface looks and behaves like shipping. The PR shows same-viewport, side-by-side screenshots (shipping web next to RN web) at phone 390x844 and tablet 1366x1024, in light and dark, plus the Android emulator. Every RN-only control in scope is removed or moved as listed. Existing behavior tests still pass, and new behavior has tests that fail without it.

**Order:** Depends on the primitive issues (U1–U7) it needs; build on those components rather than one-off styles.

Shipping is the spec. Read the shipping component first, then match it. The `design` skill names the vocabulary. The parity inventory that produced this issue (2026-10-13) captured screenshot pairs in `/tmp/splotch-parity/` on the build host; regenerate any you need.

**RN-only controls to remove or move** for this surface: see the epic list (https://github.com/KyleMit/Splotch/issues/2690#issuecomment-6147912989).

Part of #2690.
